# dsh-model-settings

Two plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
that put every model choice of DSH on one settings page: the

default model of every
profile, a switch that turns DeepSeek off completely, the web search provider

, and the
model that subagents run on.
Русская версия
| Package | What it does |
| `dsh-model-defaults` | The **Default model** page in DSH Web settings and the host routes behind i

t. |
| `dsh-web-search-extra` | Extra providers for the `web_search` tool: **SearXNG** (with an opti
onal short answer written by a DSH model), **Claude** through a Claude Code subscription, and **Auto
short answer written by a DSH model), **Claude** through a Claude Code subscription, and **Auto**. |
The page works without the search plugin; the extra search options then show as not installed.
## Why
DSH has no single "default model" setting:
* the model last picked in any conversation's composer silently becomes the default — for the `web`

profile only;
* headless runs (`dsh --profile headless`: CLI jobs, bots, schedulers) keep their own

default, which the UI cannot change;
* DeepSeek is part of the base profile: its providers cannot be
removed on the Models page, and `web_search` calls the DeepSeek API whatever model you use.
## The settings page
Settings → **Default model**:
* **Model** and **reasoning effort**, from the live DSH model catalog — every provider set up in Set

tings → Models.
* **Where to apply it**: the web UI (new conversations in every workspace) and the `

headless` profile. The current model of each is shown.
* **Turn DeepSeek models off** in every profi

le at once.
* **Web search**: DeepSeek (the DSH default), SearXNG, Claude, or Auto (DeepSeek → SearX

NG → Claude, the first answer wins). **Test search** runs one real query.
* **Subagents**: one choic
e for all delegated work — Auto (the conversation's model), a Claude model through Claude Code, or a

ny model of the DSH catalog.
* Hints: conversations already started keep their model; a **Restart DS
H Web** button appears only when the live model list no longer matches the profile file.
### Models are listed automatically
* **DSH models** come from the same catalog the composer uses (`sessionController.modelCatalog()`),

so a provider added in Settings → Models appears on the page at once.
* **Claude models** come from
Claude Code itself: the plugin asks the Claude Agent SDK for `supportedModels()` of the local Claude
Code login. The probe sends no message, so no tokens are spent; it is cached for an hour, and the *
*Refresh** link asks again. Without the SDK or a login the page falls back to the aliases `opus`, `s
onnet`, `haiku` and says so.
### Languages
English, Chinese and Russian. The page follows the DSH language setting (Settings → General → Langua
ge) and falls back to English. DSH versions without a Russian UI language get one added by the plugi
n; untranslated DSH texts then show in English.
## Requirements

* DSH 0.2.1 or newer (tested with 0.2.1-rc.5) and Node.js 22+.
* `pnpm` on `PATH` when running `dsh

plugin add` (it forwards to pnpm).
* For SearXNG search: a SearXNG instance with the JSON format on

(see SearXNG).
* For Claude search and Claude subagents: the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code`
plugin and a Claude Code login on the machine.

Search provider settings are described in `dsh-web-search-extra`.
## SearXNG
Any SearXNG instance with the JSON output format works. A private one in Docker, bound to localhost:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The first start writes `~/searxng/config/settings.yml`. In it, set `search.formats` to
`[html, json]

`, `server.limiter: false` (the instance is private) and a random
`server.secret_key`, then `docker
restart searxng`. Keep `settings.yml` out of git — it holds the secret key.
## Security

* All routes are DSH routes: they need the DSH login cookie. `POST` routes also require
the header `

x-dsh-model-defaults: 1` and a JSON body, so another site cannot send them as a form.
* Profile file

s are edited with DSH's own `yaml` library (comments and `!!js` expressions survive),
under DSH's pr

ofile lock, with an atomic write and a backup (`cordis.patch.yml.bak-model-defaults-*`,
last 5 kept)

. After each write `dsh --profile <name> --dump-config` must succeed and contain the chosen
provider

, otherwise the file is rolled back.
* Restart runs `systemctl --user --no-block restart <webUnit>`

only when `webUnit` is configured.
* The Claude model probe starts Claude Code with no tools, no set

tings, hooks or MCP servers, and a minimal
environment; it never sends a prompt. Claude search runs

Claude Code with the WebSearch tool only, in an
empty temporary folder.
